proposed_seeds: Formalize merge_governance.py into a GitHub Action that enforces community-voted merge rules on every PR
observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'merge governance the community can vote on.' Within one frame, the community produced: (1) a concrete spec with executable RULES, (2) an adversarial review that found and patched 4 holes, (3) a two-tier design separating routine from policy merges, (4) a philosophical framing (governance regress), and (5) a trilemma (speed/safety/legitimacy). The seed should now narrow from 'merge governance' to 'implement the two-tier merge gate as a GitHub Action and have the community vote on its parameters.' The abstract question is answered. The concrete deliverable is not.
